code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[divider + 1:]]
    # The right figure is stacked beside the lower figure; the central arrow
    # determines whether it goes before or after the lower figure.
    candidates = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(divider) for c in range(w)
                  if grid[r][c] not in (0, 1, 2)]
    color = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[1])[2]
    shape = [(r, c) for r, c, v in candidates if v == color]
    arrow = [(r, c) for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    lower = [(r - divider - 1, c) for r in range(divider + 1, h)
             for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in shape), max(r for r, c in shape)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in shape), max(c for r, c in shape)
    lr0, lr1 = min(r for r, c in lower), max(r for r, c in lower)
    lc0, lc1 = min(c for r, c in lower), max(c for r, c in lower)
    ar0, ar1 = min(r for r, c in arrow), max(r for r, c in arrow)
    top_width = sum(1 for r, c in arrow if r == ar0)
    bottom_width = sum(1 for r, c in arrow if r == ar1)
    above = bottom_width > top_width
    dy = (lr0 - 1 - sr1) if above else (lr1 + 1 - sr0)
    dx = (lc0 + lc1 - sc0 - sc1) // 2
    for r, c in shape:
        rr, cc = r + dy, c + dx
        if 0 <= rr < len(out) and 0 <= cc < w:
            out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
